beats.narration_text: A careful German physicist, he just wanted to explain the glow of hot objects.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A careful German physicist, he just wanted to explain the glow of hot objects.

beats.narration_text: Classical physics said that glow should blast out endless ultraviolet.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Classical physics said that glow should blast out endless ultraviolet.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Extreme close-up of an open industrial furnace door, molten white-hot metal glowing at its core, intense radiant heat shimmer distorting the air, a few sparks drifting upward, deep blacks surrounding a blinding hot center, slow dolly-in, high-contrast cinematic, anamorphic, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: Planck's fix: energy comes in discrete chunks — E equals h times frequency.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Planck's fix: energy comes in discrete chunks — E equals h times frequency.

beats.narration_text: That one idea underlies every transistor and laser in your pocket.
beats.tts_normalized_text: That one idea underlies every transistor and laser in your pocket.
beats.higgsfield_prompt: Extreme macro of a silicon semiconductor wafer rotating slowly, mirror-like surface with rainbow diffraction, fine etched circuitry and microscopic transistor arrays, cool blue and cyan light, clean high-tech laboratory, shallow rack focus drifting across the surface, cinematic, 5 seconds, no text, no people

beats.narration_text: It won him the Nobel Prize in nineteen-eighteen, and opened the quantum age.
beats.tts_normalized_text: It won him the Nobel Prize in nineteen eighteen, and opened the quantum age.

beats.narration_text: Max Planck — the reluctant father of the quantum, who never quite embraced the strange new world he had opened, yet changed physics forever.
